title: The Seed Library
summary_ko: 준이와 미나가 선생님과 함께 씨앗을 나누는 특별한 도서관을 만들어 이웃들과 식물 키우는 기쁨을 나눠요.

sentences.text: Jun walked into class and saw small paper packets on every desk.
sentences.translation_ko: 준이는 교실에 들어서다 책상마다 작은 종이 봉투가 놓인 걸 발견했어요.

sentences.text: "What are these?" he asked, picking one up.
sentences.translation_ko: "이게 뭐예요?" 준이가 봉투를 들어 올리며 물었어요.

sentences.text: Ms. Park smiled and held up a tiny seed between her fingers.
sentences.translation_ko: 박 선생님이 손가락 사이에 작은 씨앗을 집어 들고 웃으며 말했어요.

sentences.text: "Today we are going to start something special together," she said.
sentences.translation_ko: "오늘 우리 함께 특별한 걸 시작할 거예요."

sentences.text: Mina opened her packet and found three round tomato seeds inside.
sentences.translation_ko: 미나가 봉투를 열자 안에 동그란 토마토 씨앗 세 알이 들어 있었어요.

sentences.text: "Seeds from a real tomato plant!" she said, her eyes wide.
sentences.translation_ko: "진짜 토마토 나무 씨앗이에요!" 미나가 눈을 크게 뜨며 말했어요.

sentences.text: Ms. Park explained that a seed library lets people borrow seeds, grow plants, and then return new seeds later.
sentences.translation_ko: 박 선생님은 씨앗 도서관에서 씨앗을 빌려 식물을 키우고 나중에 새 씨앗을 돌려줄 수 있다고 설명했어요.

sentences.text: "It is like a book library, but for seeds," she added.
sentences.translation_ko: "책 도서관과 같은데, 씨앗으로 하는 거예요."

sentences.text: Jun thought it was a great idea.
sentences.translation_ko: 준이는 정말 좋은 생각이라고 느꼈어요.

sentences.text: "If we share seeds, everyone can have a garden even without a big yard," he said.
sentences.translation_ko: "씨앗을 나누면 넓은 마당이 없어도 누구나 텃밭을 가꿀 수 있어요."

sentences.text: Mina nodded and smiled at him.
sentences.translation_ko: 미나도 고개를 끄덕이며 준이를 향해 웃었어요.

sentences.text: The class started making small envelopes out of old newspaper.
sentences.translation_ko: 반 친구들은 헌 신문지로 작은 봉투를 만들기 시작했어요.

sentences.text: Each student wrote the plant name and the date on the front.
sentences.translation_ko: 학생들은 앞면에 식물 이름과 날짜를 적었어요.

sentences.text: Jun wrote "sunflower" on his envelope in his neatest handwriting.
sentences.translation_ko: 준이는 가장 예쁜 글씨로 봉투에 '해바라기'라고 썼어요.

sentences.text: He had saved the seeds from his grandmother's garden last autumn.
sentences.translation_ko: 지난가을 할머니 텃밭에서 모아 둔 씨앗이었어요.

sentences.text: Ms. Park brought out a big wooden box decorated with colorful drawings.
sentences.translation_ko: 박 선생님이 알록달록한 그림으로 꾸민 커다란 나무 상자를 가져왔어요.

sentences.text: "This will be our seed library box," she announced proudly.
sentences.translation_ko: "이게 우리 씨앗 도서관 상자예요." 선생님이 자랑스럽게 말했어요.

sentences.text: One by one, students placed their seed envelopes inside the box.
sentences.translation_ko: 학생들이 차례차례 씨앗 봉투를 상자 안에 넣었어요.

sentences.text: Soon the box was full of many different kinds of seeds.
sentences.translation_ko: 이내 상자는 온갖 종류의 씨앗으로 가득 찼어요.

sentences.text: "We have sunflowers, carrots, beans, and even mint!" Mina said.
sentences.translation_ko: "해바라기, 당근, 콩, 그리고 민트도 있어요!" 미나가 말했어요.

sentences.text: Ms. Park said that neighbors and parents could also borrow seeds.
sentences.translation_ko: 박 선생님은 이웃과 부모님도 씨앗을 빌려 갈 수 있다고 했어요.

sentences.text: "When their plants grow, they will bring back more seeds to share," she explained.
sentences.translation_ko: "식물이 자라면 씨앗을 더 많이 가져와서 나눌 거예요."

sentences.text: After school, Jun told his mother about the seed library.
sentences.translation_ko: 학교가 끝난 후 준이는 엄마에게 씨앗 도서관 이야기를 했어요.

sentences.text: She was so excited that she gave him a bag of pepper seeds to donate.
sentences.translation_ko: 엄마는 너무 신이 나서 기증할 고추 씨앗 한 봉지를 건네줬어요.

sentences.text: The next morning, Jun proudly added the pepper seeds to the box.
sentences.translation_ko: 다음 날 아침 준이는 자랑스럽게 고추 씨앗을 상자에 추가했어요.

sentences.text: "Our library is already growing," Mina laughed.
sentences.translation_ko: "우리 도서관이 벌써 커지고 있어요." 미나가 웃으며 말했어요.

sentences.text: Ms. Park looked at the overflowing box and felt proud of the class.
sentences.translation_ko: 박 선생님은 씨앗이 넘칠 것 같은 상자를 보며 반 아이들이 자랑스러웠어요.

sentences.text: "When we share what we have, everyone grows," she said softly.
sentences.translation_ko: "우리가 가진 걸 나누면 모두가 함께 자라요." 선생님이 조용히 말했어요.

sentences.text: Jun and Mina smiled, already dreaming of the garden they would grow.
sentences.translation_ko: 준이와 미나는 앞으로 가꿀 텃밭을 벌써 꿈꾸며 미소 지었어요.
